_readme: Model combinations offered by the 'Set the best combination' button in Settings. This file is read fresh on every request — edit it, save, refresh the app: no rebuild needed. To update after new models come out: check prices/quality at https://openrouter.ai/models (the app's own list is at GET /api/models/openrouter and includes per-token prices), edit the model ids below, and bump 'updated'. Slot meanings: searchModel = query building + scoring every found job (runs dozens of times per search, cheap+fast matters); tailorModel = writes the CV + cover letter (biggest quality lever); reviewModel = critiques the draft against the user's real materials (a different family than the tailor catches more); applyModel = assists form auto-fill; generalModel = job-page/screenshot extraction and misc (should be vision-capable). 'codex' is the local Codex CLI (user's ChatGPT plan).

presets.name: Cheapest
presets.tagline: Pennies per application — surprisingly decent quality.
presets.notes: Gemini Flash Lite ($0.10/M) scores jobs fast; GPT-5.4 Mini is the best cheap writer; DeepSeek V4 Flash reviews from a different model family for almost nothing; Gemini 2.5 Flash handles screenshots (vision).

presets.name: Balanced — recommended
presets.tagline: Strong CVs at a fair price. The sweet spot for most people.
presets.notes: Claude Sonnet 5 ($2/M in) is currently the best writing value — newer AND cheaper than Sonnet 4.5. Grok 4.3 ranks jobs quickly; GPT-5.4 Mini gives a cross-family second opinion on every draft.

presets.name: Best quality
presets.tagline: Cost is no object — the strongest available combination.
presets.notes: Claude Fable 5 ($10/M in) is Anthropic's top model and an exceptional writer; GPT-5.5 reviews every draft from the rival family; even job scoring runs on Sonnet 5, and Opus 4.8 handles extraction.

presets.name: Your ChatGPT plan
presets.tagline: No extra cost — everything runs on your ChatGPT subscription via the local Codex CLI.
presets.estimatedCost: ≈ $0 extra (counts against your ChatGPT plan limits)
presets.notes: Requires the Codex CLI installed and logged in (codex login). Job searches will be noticeably slower — every job score spawns a local Codex run — and generate+review+refine uses the same model family, so there is no cross-family critic. Great for trying things without spending OpenRouter credit.
